title: Standardize internal agent tools to wiki namespace
summary: Rename live internal agent tools from codewiki_* to wiki_* (wiki_state, wiki_resume_context, wiki_roadmap, wiki_gateway, wiki_audit, etc.) with no compatibility aliases.

goal.outcome: All live internal agent tool names use the wiki_* namespace and no codewiki_* compatibility aliases remain.
acceptance: Pi tool registration exposes wiki_* names for all internal CodeWiki tools.
No live codewiki_* tool names remain in registration, schemas, skills, README, or tests except historical build/validation/archive artifacts.
Tool guidance aligns internal wiki_* names with user-facing /wiki-* command naming.
Package smoke tests assert old codewiki_* names are absent and wiki_* names are present.
non_goals: Do not change user-facing /wiki-* command names except docs needed for clarity.
Do not migrate source layer names unrelated to tool registration.
verification: search proves live codewiki_* tool names are absent.

delta.desired: Internal agent tools use wiki_* names with no compatibility aliases.
delta.current: Internal agent tools use codewiki_* names; user-facing commands use /wiki-* names.
delta.closure: Close when live registration/docs/tests use wiki_* and validation passes.
